name: near-1
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 env OPENSPIDER_NEAR_DUP_THREADS=1 cargo test -p os-analyze --test near_dup_n16 --test near_dup_d02 -j 6 --locked

name: near-8
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 env OPENSPIDER_NEAR_DUP_THREADS=8 cargo test -p os-analyze --test near_dup_n16 --test near_dup_d02 -j 6 --locked

name: frontend
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 npm run -w apps/desktop typecheck && timeout 3600s nice -n 10 npm run -w apps/desktop test && timeout 3600s nice -n 10 npm run -w apps/desktop check:static

name: bridge-build
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 cargo build -j 6 --locked -p os-app --features e2e-bridge --bin os-app-bridge

name: tools-build
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 cargo build -j 6 --locked -p os-testsite -p os-cli -p os-parity --bins

name: e2e
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 npm run -w apps/desktop e2e -- e2e/beta e2e/mcp e2e/a11y --project=chromium --project=webkit --workers=4

name: deny
command: timeout 3600s nice -n 10 cargo deny check licenses bans sources

name: frontend-retry
command: npm ci; npm run -w apps/desktop typecheck && npm run -w apps/desktop test && npm run -w apps/desktop check:static (je timeout 3600s nice -n 10)
